scope: Realtime voice calls: acoustic gating and end-of-user-turn recovery. Dictation/voice-message gate defaults unchanged.
causes: A candidate sound prevented the adaptive noise floor from updating, so stationary voice-band noise could remain classified as speech.
Every speech-gated positive audio level renewed the turn silence deadline without a limit on stalled ASR content.
Detected speech without recognized text never armed a session fallback or notified the session of an empty completed recognition turn.
changes: Conversation-only stationary background adaptation uses fifty 20 ms frames and learns stable energy even after the gate opens; preserves modulation/quiet speech behavior and retains background calibration across recognition turns.
Use independent silence and ASR-progress deadlines. The normal proficiency-specific 1.0–1.8 s silence delay remains; default maximum no-progress wait is 6 s, not an utterance duration limit.
Track high-water marks for recognized word/letter-digit counts; repeated hypotheses, case and punctuation changes do not indefinitely reset progress.
Arm recovery on detected speech even before a partial transcript. An empty final returns a detected input turn to listening without invoking the conversation client.
Cancel/reset endpoint evidence on restart, suspend, mute and completed input. Request finalization once per turn; existing Apple 500 ms finalization fallback remains.

coverage: Stationary mid-frequency tones after genuine speech at 16/48 kHz; calibration survives turn reset.
Quiet modulated 3-second speech across three tap sizes and trailing silence.
Continuous false-positive activity and repeatedly revised partial text cannot wait indefinitely.
Empty noise turn returns to listening, never calls AI, and permits the next real answer.
Genuine new words extend a long turn beyond the no-progress limit.
Existing barge-in, mute, endpoint, cancellation, hangup and admitted-response lifecycle cases.

preview.computerUse: Opened the preview chat in Device Hub through AX. Device Hub screenshot was blank and call toolbar was not exposed; no physical microphone/call acoustic acceptance claimed.

limits: Deterministic synthetic PCM and injected recognition/playback fixtures; no real room, speaker echo, Bluetooth or live ASR accuracy measurement.
No live AI calls, production data changes, backend deployment or App Store publication.
